headline: Peru Central Bank Reports Sol Interbank Rates Average 4.25% in October
summary: Data from Banco Central de Reserva del Perú showed average interbank interest rates in soles reached 4.25% annually in late October, while dollar-denominated interbank rates settled at 4.00%.
why: BCRP monetary policy rates anchor commercial lending costs and liquidity across Peru's banking sector.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Interbank rates reflect short-term liquidity conditions set by central bank open market operations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
